name: form
title: Form
description: The rhythm of a form: rows, sections and actions that follow their column.
use: A form whose rows, sections and closing buttons stack by the width of the form itself, not of the viewport. It draws no surface and holds no state. A few fields in one column with nothing beside them are written with utilities alone: flex flex-col and a gap.

instead.when: It is one label with its control, its hint and its error

platform.fallback: Rows and sections stay stacked, and the actions stay in a line at the end

classes.name: form
classes.description: The column of fields, at one distance, and a size container named form. Its width must come from its context

classes.name: form-row
classes.description: Fields read as one line; they share it in equal columns from 28rem of form and stack below

classes.name: form-section
classes.description: A heading with the fields it describes; from 40rem of form the heading stands beside them at a third of the width. Sections are parted by a hairline

classes.name: form-heading
classes.description: The title and the description of a section

classes.name: form-description
classes.description: A sentence under the title of a section

classes.name: form-fields
classes.description: The fields of a section, at the form's distance

classes.name: form-actions
classes.description: The closing buttons, at the end with the confirming one last; below 24rem of form they stack at full width with the confirming one first
